headline: MONEY METALS: U.S. TREASURY BUYS LONG BONDS TO CRUSH YIELDS — THE INTERVENTION THAT SENT GOLD THROUGH $4,500
snippet: Money Metals Exchange explains today that Wednesday's 4.13% gold surge to $4,512 was not a spontaneous rally — it was the direct consequence of the U.S. Treasury announcing it would increase purchases of long-term bonds as a debt-management measure, effectively suppressing long-end yields outside the Federal Reserve's mandate. The piece frames this as a watershed moment: when the Treasury itself has to intervene in the bond market to prevent yields from rising on its own debt, it signals that fiscal dominance has arrived. For gold and silver holders, this is the structural argument made manifest — the Fed is not the only player backing the precious metals bid.

headline: UR-ENERGY SHIPS FIRST URANIUM FROM SHIRLEY BASIN — WYOMING NOW A TWO-MINE ISR PLATFORM WITH 4.2M LB/YEAR CAPACITY
snippet: Ur-Energy Ltd. (TSX: URE; NYSE American: URG) made the first shipment of uranium from its Shirley Basin mine to the Lost Creek processing plant on August 19, marking its transition from a single-asset to a multi-asset domestic U.S. uranium producer. Shirley Basin moved from construction decision to first production in just two and a half years; the satellite ISR mine holds licensed capacity of 2.0 million pounds of U3O8 equivalent annually. Combined with Lost Creek, the Wyoming platform now carries 4.2 million pounds of total licensed annual capacity — a meaningful throughput step-up as U.S. utilities urgently seek domestic supply alternatives to Russian and Kazakh material.

headline: SIRIOS RESOURCES EXTENDS CHEECHOO BEYOND 2025 MRE — 2.4 g/t Au OVER 48.5M CONFIRMS OPEN DEPTH IN JAMES BAY
snippet: Sirios Resources (TSXV: SOI) announced August 20 that Phase 1 drilling at the Cheechoo gold project in the Eeyou Istchee Baie-James region of Quebec intersected 2.4 g/t gold over 48.5 metres in the first 5 holes totalling 1,753 metres, confirming that the deposit extends beyond the boundary of the 2025 resource estimate. Visible gold was observed in hole CH26-326 and seven additional holes with assays pending. Cheechoo sits within one of the highest-activity gold belts in Canada, and a resource extension result at this grade width — delivered at $4,480 gold — goes directly to the upside case for the next resource update.

headline: HELIOSTAR (HSTR) HITS ANTIMONY + GOLD AT GOLDSTRIKE UTAH — FIRST-EVER Sb DRILL PROGRAM LAUNCHED 4KM EAST OF RESOURCE
snippet: Heliostar Metals (TSXV: HSTR) announced that sampling at its 100% owned Goldstrike project in Utah returned high-grade antimony alongside gold at zones located up to four kilometres east of the established Goldstrike gold resource, and that the first-ever antimony-focused drilling program on the property has commenced. Antimony — a critical mineral with no producing domestic North American source — has been emerging as a dual-target commodity alongside gold at several western U.S. properties. The identification of a new Sb-Au corridor well beyond the existing resource envelope meaningfully expands the project's optionality ahead of assay results.

headline: 100+ DEAD IN CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC ARTISANAL GOLD MINE COLLAPSE — TUNNELS FAIL IN NANA-MAMBERE REGION
snippet: More than 100 people were killed and others remain trapped after multiple underground tunnels collapsed at an unregulated artisanal gold mine in the village of Zamboye, Nana-Mambere prefecture, Central African Republic, near the border with Cameroon. Thousands of informal workers operate small-scale extraction mines in the CAR with minimal safety infrastructure; the country's public prosecutor attributed the collapse to the failure of "several underground tunnels in which miners were operating." The scale of the event — the worst artisanal mining disaster in Central Africa this year — will likely renew international ESG scrutiny on informal gold supply chains and strengthen the relative positioning of regulated, permitted junior mining projects in Western jurisdictions.

headline: DON DURRETT: 15 GOLD-SILVER MINERS AS "LOW-HANGING FRUIT" — $7,000 GOLD AND $200 SILVER THE 2-3 YEAR THESIS
snippet: In his August 19 Seeking Alpha piece, veteran precious metals analyst Don Durrett names 15 gold and silver mining stocks as speculative buys with asymmetric upside, anchored to an aggressive macro thesis: U.S. fiscal dominance, persistent structural deficits, and a multi-year currency reset scenario that he projects could drive gold to $7,000 and silver to $200 within two to three years. The piece advocates disciplined low-allocation speculation with a long-term hold, explicitly targeting miners that offer leveraged exposure rather than physical metal. With GDX already up 21% this week and miners trading at historically compressed P/E multiples despite record margins, Durrett's framing of this as a momentum-entry window — not a top — captures the current institutional debate.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD AND SILVER Q2: $46M REVENUE +71% YoY — REALIZED SILVER NEARLY DOUBLES TO $67/oz ON COSALÁ GRADES
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation (TSX: USA; NYSE American: USAS) reported Q2 2026 net revenue of $46 million, up 71% year-over-year, as realized silver prices nearly doubled to $67 per ounce versus $34 in Q2 2025. The Cosalá operation in Mexico delivered 337,000 ounces of silver — a 26% year-on-year increase — on higher silver grades across fewer processed tonnes. Adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $12 million and the net loss narrowed sharply to $5 million ($0.02/share) from $15 million a year ago. The Phase 2 Galena No. 3 Shaft modernization was completed during the quarter, lifting hoisting capacity 150% and setting the stage for a throughput step-up at the Idaho silver complex in H2 2026.

headline: SAVANNAH RESOURCES SEALS 3 BARROSO COMMUNITY LAND PACTS — EUROPE'S LARGEST LITHIUM PROJECT TARGETS FID BY END-2026
snippet: Savannah Resources has signed three new benefit-sharing agreements with baldio communal landholding groups adjacent to the Barroso Lithium Project in northern Portugal — Europe's largest lithium development, carrying €110 million in EU strategic grant funding and a €417 million capex. Each deal includes community participation in project oversight, inflation-indexed land compensation, and reinvestment of derived benefits. The agreements move Savannah closer to a Final Investment Decision it is targeting by year-end 2026, with construction to begin in 2027 and first production of 25,000 tonnes per annum of lithium concentrate in late 2028. The project holds Strategic Project status under the European Critical Raw Materials Act — EU-level political cover that has become a key differentiator for European lithium developers facing community opposition.

headline: MINING BOSSES: REGULATORY SCRUTINY IS UP BUT M&A IS NOT BLOCKED — GLENCORE, ANGLO, RIO SPEAK AFTER HALF-YEAR RESULTS
snippet: Executives at Glencore, Anglo American, and Rio Tinto said in August 19 post-results commentary that antitrust and national security reviews of mining deals are becoming more prominent — particularly for copper and other critical minerals — but are not making large transactions unworkable. The comments come as major copper-heavy M&A is widely anticipated given record copper prices and depleting reserve bases at senior producers. For junior miners with critical mineral assets in Western jurisdictions, the message is clear: the window for strategic investment and earn-in transactions remains open, but deals with foreign-state links or cross-border critical mineral concentration will face longer regulatory timelines.
